title: Mixed Event — Doll Festival at the Tenma's — Episode7 More Ragged Than This Doll...

meta.Episode: Episode7 — More Ragged Than This Doll...
meta.Event Outline: It's the first Doll Festival since Saki returned to school! In the midst of his enthusiastic preparations, Tsukasa looks back on a bitter childhood memory. He then executes his plan to do something special for Saki, but will it go as he hopes...?!

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Doll Festival♪ Doll Festival♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, is there a bowl or plate I can put the rice puffs in?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
Let's see, they can go in... This one!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks. Oh, this one looks cute.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I really like that one♪
Tsukasa bought it for me way back...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Shiho!
How are things over there?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, the food's all ready now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, that looks amazing!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All I did was put what your mom made onto some plates. Is there anything else we need to do?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That should be it! Thanks so much, you two! All that's left to do is wait for Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. I hope her committee meeting gets to end early...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. But now that I can see it all, there's a ton of food and snacks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It felt like we did a lot, but this still isn't everything, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha, yeah... Tsukasa bought a lot of stuff for us yesterday and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He said he wanted to make sure we had as much fun as...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, something definitely happened between Saki and Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can see that. Did they get into an argument or something? I can't really imagine what they would fight about...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right! Take a look at this too! The Tenma family's special dolls! Including a seven-tiered stand and all the fixings!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This really is something else. Even the clothes they're wearing are fancier than normal...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Oh, except for the ones at the top. Why are they so dirty?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Their kimonos are torn in some spots too. Did you do that while playing with them, Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I would never do something like that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They're dirty because Tsukasa did something very thoughtful for me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. This happened when we were still little...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (I didn't get to celebrate the Doll Festival at home this year either...)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (I really liked the cake mom and dad got me but...)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I really wanted to see our huge doll stand too...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (No, I'm starting to feel sad...)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (I can't let everyone see me this way or ask for too much. Otherwise, they'll start worrying about me...)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Huh...? T-Tsukasa?!
Did you forget something?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... Yes!
I forgot my handkerchief...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Your handkerchief...?
Oh, here you go!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thanks, Saki...!
I'll be back later too!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, bye...
Wait, later...?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (What did he mean by that? Is he talking about visiting me tomorrow too...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (And it's already dark...)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (I'm happy that we celebrated the Doll Festival together, but I do feel lonely here...)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... Saki!!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Tsukasa?
Did you forget something else?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, it's not that!
I came here to bring you these!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Th-Those are our dolls...!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: But why...?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I... I really wanted you to see them...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I couldn't bring them all, so I thought I could bring at least the ones at the very top to show you!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (Did he do this because he realized I was feeling sad...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... I'm so sorry... I fell on the way here and got them all dirty...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: They mean so much to you but I...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
(Tsukasa's really hurt.
Worse than the dolls...)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (He's covered in scrapes and bruises too. He must be in so much pain, but he came anyway...)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (I'm happy that he brought me these dolls but...)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (I'm even happier that he came all this way for me...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (Oh no... I'm so happy, I might start crying...)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: No, it's okay! I'm really happy that you did this...!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Thank you, Tsukasa! Doing all of this for me...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is what happened...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I wanted everyone to see those dolls, so I decided to have a party to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I never knew...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's so adorable.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mom and dad even asked a few times to see if they should buy some new ones, but I kept telling them that I like them just the way they are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: These dolls are the most important thing in the world to me. Tsukasa and I are tied together by them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why I don't want any new ones...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But Saki. Did something happen between you and...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that must be Hona!
I'll go take a look.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Coming♪ Welcome!
Wait, huh...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Uh, please excuse the sudden intrusion...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Toya?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, did you come here to party with us? Come right in!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, Tsukasa hasn't come home yet but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No... There's something I need to tell you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... I apologize in advance for butting into your business but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa told me about the fight you had with him about your dolls.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I fully understand that you didn't want him to do such a thing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But Tsukasa put quite a lot of thought into your gift.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's been saving up for years in order to see you smile and be happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? Tsukasa never mentioned anything like that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What he got may've ended up being not to your liking but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just wanted you to understand why he did what he did and how much thought he put into it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Let's make the most of it since we're going to have so many people join us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa... He does so much for me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I just...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aaahhhhh!!!
Saki!! Sakiii!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ts-Tsukasa...?!
